title: Opposition to mineral reservation area proposal in Mindoro grows

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Opposition is mounting against a proposal to declare portions of San Teodoro and Puerto Galera in Oriental Mindoro as a Mineral Reservation Area (MRA), with provincial and municipal lawmakers as well as religious leaders rejecting the plan. On Monday, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan (provincial board) passed a resolution opposing the proposal, which covers about 10,265.3 hectares of mountainous land straddling the two northern Mindoro towns. On the same day, the Sangguniang Bayan (municipal council) of Puerto Galera unanimously passed Resolution 11-372-2026, formally objecting to the municipality’s inclusion of the municipality in the proposed MRA.
